from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class JudicialDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single legal judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title as named in the text, e.g. 《判决文书 1》")
    cause_of_action: Literal[
        '行政行为 - 行政补偿',
        '海事海商纠纷',
        '行政行为 - 行政处罚',
        '行政行为 - 行政复议',
        '继承纠纷',
        '行政行为 - 行政合同',
        '合同，无因管理，不当得利纠纷',
        '非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿'
    ] | None = Field(description="The legal cause of action category for this document, drawn from the fixed task taxonomy")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted judicial documents for downstream classification grouping."""
    documents: list[JudicialDocument]
